## Result

Skill: design-review. Review status: approved. Recording status: recorded. Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-08-skill-model-proposal-family-pilot/reviews/design-review-r3.json. Scope: exact Skill/System package reassessment after bounded final wording correction, with retained source/consumer mappings and approved direction unchanged. No new finding. Original-reporter disposition resolves skl-cr-002 only. Next stage: return to route for Delivery-basis assessment and remaining implementation correction; no final Code Review, Verify or adoption claim.

## Independence and basis

This agent did not author Skill/System, the correction, implementation or tests. Earlier Design and Code Reviews were assessments only. The same original reporter independently evaluates its final-review concern. Fresh primary subjects bind revised Skill sha256:b2a9edc9b9fea3fd45e168e64ad0d2db9a8550f1308f303ede49f2cdcd70feaf and unchanged System sha256:7b1b603cc7fb2f79ab5dabd1f275e58884a19f612a663a45bfab3a4ed03fd8f5, plus the explicitly inspected retained source and consumer basis. The approved proposal and plan remain unchanged. Old Design r2 is retained on its original subject and restricted applicability; this is a new judgment rather than retargeting it.

The complete Skill/System and source package were inspected in preceding independent Design and fresh final whole-change assessments. Current primary full-subject inspection and exact diff show only the first sentence of Skill's applicability paragraph changed relative to that final assessment; retained tables, source dispositions, examples, decisions, interfaces, pilot files and expected proof remain identical. These unchanged semantic assessments are reused with affirmative byte-based scope, not inferred from old approval alone. Implemented source displacement supplies current concrete context; this Design assessment does not replace assessment of that implementation.

## Correction outcome

“Replacement authority is conditional on coherent adoption” is stable engineering intent. The following unchanged sentences continue to require reviewed implementation and successful Verify, keep current governing contracts operational until that boundary, reject activation by saving/Design approval alone, preserve exact existing populations/exemptions/equivalents, and bound SKL-SR-16–19 to the named pair. No current progress is asserted. The original stale awaiting-assessment/implementation statement is gone. Constitution's stable-intent/current-record boundary is satisfied without weakening adoption or silently declaring it complete.

## Eight review criteria

| Criterion | Result | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Technical realization supports required behavior | pass | Same body/reference/assets and validator/candidate decomposition; no behavior or failure outcome changed. |
| 2. Required behavior respects constraints | pass | Stable conditional wording preserves governance, compatibility, package and no-publication constraints. |
| 3. Feasibility does not weaken approved goals | pass | Precise retained contract and evidenced bounded pilot remain required; no scope/quality concession. |
| 4. Boundaries are explicit and consistent | pass | Current lifecycle remains registry-owned; adoption, recording, review and implementation stay distinct. |
| 5. Decisions and history are preserved | pass | SKL-DEC-01–05 and old exact-subject judgments retain original identities/meaning; only misleading mutable wording changes. |
| 6. Shared owners and consumers reconcile | pass | Skill/System, retained specialist clauses, current architecture references, archive and operational consumers retain the reviewed map. |
| 7. Claims have credible basis and outcomes | pass | Existing representative ordinary/formal, package failure, non-pilot and archival outcomes remain adequate for Delivery. Structural checks are not semantic approval. |
| 8. Requirements/source meaning remain complete | pass | Actual metadata, role-summary, vocabulary, portability-lint/enforcement populations, fallback/package distinction and all selected surviving clauses remain unchanged and actionable; no transfer is replaced with generic preservation text. |

## Evidence and limitations

Actually performed: exact git diff, applicable Design Review instructions, prior full package assessment reuse under matching identities, fresh primary context and full subject inspection, and complete author correction evidence inspection. Author's model/prose/git-diff checks passed and bind exact revised Skill/System. No package test, publication, implementation correctness or Verify claim is made by this Design review.

The separate skl-cr-003 stale lifecycle fixture/validation correction remains open. Its implementation and final composed proof must be independently assessed. Delivery must explicitly determine whether the unchanged plan allocation remains applicable to this corrected governing subject. Final whole-change Code Review must be fresh after all corrections. This judgment supports those authorized owner activities only.
independence_basis: Independent agent authored no reviewed engineering or correction. Prior activity was assessment only; original final-review reporter now assesses the exact stable-wording correction and unchanged complete package.
